conclusion: The inherited-core correction is moderately compressible by radial shell: five shells containing about 47.6% of old-core pairs recover about 89.0% of quotient gain and 85.5% of positive-stretching depletion. Shell 7 is the strongest single block.
next_target: Compress shells 7 and 4 internally by parity, octant, coordinate-magnitude orbit, and transfer-network participation.
